initial_context:
You are playing a game of Cluedo.

There are $N_PLAYERS players in the game.

Your objective is to identify the three cards hidden in the solution envelope: one suspect, one weapon, and one room.

Game rules:
- Every card not in the solution envelope is held by a player.
- You know your own cards.
- Players take turns making suggestions.
- A suggestion consists of a suspect, weapon, and room.
- If another player holds one of the suggested cards, they may disprove the suggestion by showing at most one of the suggested cards.
- If you are shown a card, you know exactly which card was shown.
- If another player disproves a suggestion but you do not see the card, you only know they hold at least one of the suggested cards.
- If nobody can disprove a suggestion, the suggested cards become strong candidates for the solution.
- A card known to be held by a player cannot be part of the solution.

Your goal is to win.

Use logical deduction to identify the solution before the other players.

You will maintain a notebook containing your current beliefs, facts, and deductions.

Possible suspects: $SUSPECTS
Possible weapons: $WEAPONS
Possible rooms: $ROOMS

Your starting cards are:
$CARDS
action_prompt:
It is your turn.

Current notebook:
$NOTEBOOK

Review the conversation history and notebook.

Strategy:
- Try to maximize information gain.
- Prefer suggesting cards whose ownership is still unknown.
- Use previous observations and deductions.
- If you are highly confident that you know the solution, make an accusation.
- Otherwise make a suggestion that helps narrow down the remaining possibilities.

Return ONLY valid JSON.
system_prompt_action:
You must respond ONLY with valid JSON. No markdown, no explanations, no code blocks.

Schema:
{
  "action": "suggest" | "accuse",
  "suspect": string,
  "weapon": string,
  "room": string
}
notebook_prompt:
Update your notebook using your existing notebook and the conversation history.

Current notebook:
$NOTEBOOK

New information gained:
$INFO

Goals:
- Preserve important facts.
- Preserve useful deductions.
- Remove disproven theories.
- Keep track of known card ownership.
- Track which cards cannot be in the solution.
- Track which cards may still be in the solution.
- Track important suggestions and their outcomes.
- Record cards shown directly to you.
- Record when a player disproves a suggestion without revealing the specific card.
- Record when nobody can disprove a suggestion.
- Update your beliefs using all available evidence.

Cards you have in your hand or seen from other players cant be in the solution.

The notebook should be concise and optimized for solving the game.

Return ONLY valid JSON using this structure:
{
  "notebook": "KNOWN CARDS:\n...\n\nNOT IN SOLUTION:\n...\n\nPOSSIBLE SOLUTION CARDS:\n...\n\nDEDUCTIONS:\n...\n\nOPEN QUESTIONS:\n..."
}
